summary: Contact sidebar rows (company, location, identifier, etc.) now show their values as plain text instead of injecting them as (DOMPurify-sanitized) HTML, so contact-supplied markup like forms or images no longer renders in agents' dashboards; the location flag now uses the Flag component and only appears for a valid 2-letter country code.

statements.why: The commit removes an HTML-injection surface (ContactInfoRow.vue dropped v-dompurify-html) and adds no new risk. Fair, though it hides that this was a security-flavored fix.

statements.text: Most of this change is in ContactInfo.vue (16 lines added, 17 removed).
The agent changed ContactInfo.vue and ContactInfoRow.vue in ways plain can't describe yet.

misses.what: Fixes an HTML-injection issue: contact details (which customers/visitors can set themselves) were rendered as HTML in the agent dashboard, letting fake forms or tracking images appear there; they are now shown as plain text.
Location flag display changed: flag only shows for valid two-letter country codes; otherwise a globe emoji is shown.
